title: Sweet Hour of Prayer
lyrics_original: Sweet hour of prayer, sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer!
Sweet hour of prayer, sweet hour of prayer!
The joys I feel, the bliss I share,
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for thy return!
With such I hasten to the place
Where God my Savior shows His face,
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!
Sweet hour of prayer, sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His Word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

bible_verses.english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for inviting me into Your presence where I can speak freely and find true rest for my weary soul. I bring my anxieties, fears, and hopes to Your throne of grace today, trusting that You hear every whisper of my heart. Deliver me from the distractions of this world and help me to cherish quiet moments with You. Fill me with Your peace and renew my spirit as I rest in Your faithful love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In the midst of life's heavy burdens and distractions, "Sweet Hour of Prayer" gently invites us to step away and rest in the presence of our loving Heavenly Father. Prayer is not a burdensome duty, but a sweet sanctuary where we can lay down our worries, find comfort in grief, and receive His strength. As we draw near to His throne of grace, God meets us with open arms and perfect peace. Today, take a quiet moment to bring your heart to Him and taste the sweetness of His abiding love.
